name: Navigation & mega menu
job: Global navigation with the real Kelwin lockup (.km-logo): Capabilities / Methodology / The Firm / Resources / The Lab, plus the AUDIT REQUEST action. Show the resting bar over the top of the frosted hero film AND the Capabilities mega menu open (three capabilities — Narrative Systems, GTM Infrastructure, GTM Intelligence — each with a 4-line service list, plus the System Audit entry point) in one composition, stage height ~760.

name: Hero
job: First viewport, with the site navbar at top. REQUIRED: the frosted background film (.km-film) — a video that keeps playing behind heavy frosted glass, silhouettes only. Thesis: 'Revenue is an architectural problem.' Sub: Kelwin designs the narrative, market intelligence and outbound systems that turn fragmented growth into repeatable pipeline. Primary CTA (red) -> request a GTM / System Audit; secondary -> methodology or contact. Founder's target: R/refs/user-kelwin-intent.webp; sibling: R/refs/user-plurel.webp.

name: The reframe
job: 'Most teams are fixing the wrong layer.' Surface vs architecture; three misdiagnoses (pipeline -> narrative architecture; sales execution -> orchestration; tooling -> GTM intelligence). Today it slides up over the held hero like a sheet; options may reinvent that hand-off.

name: Structural evidence
job: 'Four numbers. One diagnosis.' Four researched readings (e.g. buyers spend 17% of the journey with sales — Gartner; 95:5 out-of-market — Ehrenberg-Bass) presented as instruments with sources.

name: The stack (four layers)
job: The Kelwin operating stack — infrastructure layers (narrative, data, deliverability/orchestration, intelligence) as one system; each layer with what it is and 'in practice'.

name: System architecture diagram
job: Signal-orchestration diagram: how narrative, channels, signals and intelligence connect into one loop. The visual centrepiece that proves 'architecture, not tactics'.

name: State change
job: 'Start compounding.' The shift from entropy to a compounding system — a state-change moment (Δ).

name: Operating principle band
job: A single principle stated large: 'In a noisy market, the clearest company wins.' A pause / manifesto beat between dense sections.

name: Methodology
job: How we install the system — four phases (diagnose -> define -> install -> compound), each with output. On the live site the pipeline advances with scroll; demo it as a timed sequence.

name: Who it's for
job: 'Not for everyone. By design.' Qualification: fit criteria (past first revenue, ready to own the system, ...) vs decline criteria.

name: What you own
job: 'When we leave, the system stays.' Inventory of the assets the client owns: narrative system, ICP & signal map, playbooks, dashboards, etc.

name: Before / after
job: Before Kelwin vs after Kelwin — six paired rows (without the system / with the system).

name: FAQ
job: Objection-handling questions (vs lead-gen agency, what the audit is, install length, replace vs work with team...). Show one item expanded.

name: Final call to action
job: The closing decision: 'Initiate System Audit' (primary, red) + 'Book a strategic call'. Deployment window open. The page's single strongest red moment.

name: Footer
job: Footer: wordmark, sitemap columns (Capabilities, Firm, Resources), contact, colophon, Privacy / Terms, location/time readout.

name: Interior page header
job: The opening of every interior page (About, Capabilities, Who we work with…). Use the Narrative Systems capability page as the worked example: page header + the first body beat (overview + start of the service manifest). No photography — the header must earn its presence through type, grid and a signature graphic.
